text:
Ava (Design): Quick design review request — updated flow for the Private/VPC setup wizard (networking step). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx. Focus: prereq checks, copy polish, and a11y for form controls. Posting screenshots + notes in thread.

Carlos (Product): skimmed — like the move to a single 'Network readiness' page instead of three tabs. Can we make the failure states clearer? Right now the red message is a bit terse. Suggest: 'Action required: inbound firewall rules blocking control-plane traffic.'

Eileen (Eng-Platform): re: prereqs — we should run an automated connectivity preflight before you let users proceed. Could surface the known checks: outbound to api.redwood.ai:443, NTP, and KMS endpoint. Also add an option to re-run checks without leaving the page.

Rajat (SRE): +1 on re-run. Also need explicit guidance for corporate proxies. A lot of infra teams have egress via proxy — we should add a small collapsible 'Corporate proxy' help panel with example env vars: `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`.

Ava (Design): noted — adjusting copy for failure states. Proposed wording for failures (short): 'Network check failed — required outbound access to api.redwood.ai:443 is blocked. Click for remediation steps.' Thoughts?

Carlos (Product): good. Also add a link to an infra checklist PDF and surface the estimated time-to-complete for each step (e.g., 'Expected: 5–10 minutes'). Users hate guessing.

Eileen (Eng-Platform): small UX nit — when a check is in progress, use a persistent spinner + 'Testing...' text and disable the 'Next' button, but still allow users to expand the detailed logs. Don't hide logs behind a modal.

Rajat (SRE): for logs, please include copy-safe samples only. Don't dump keys or IPs. Example quick debug commands we can show in the UI:
```
# test HTTPS to control plane
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/healthcheck
# test DNS resolution
nslookup api.redwood.ai
```
These are safe and actionable.

Ava (Design): will add those commands as collapsible 'Debug' snippets. For accessibility: changing the checkbox group to use role="group" + aria-describedby, and ensure focus goes to the first error after validation. Also need color-contrast improvements on the failure banner.

Carlos (Product): copy tweak for success state — current 'Ready' feels casual. Maybe 'Network validated — ready for provisioning.' More explicit.

Eileen (Eng-Platform): operational question — if KV cache endpoints or S3 endpoints are required on-prem, do we want the wizard to allow 'skip' with a big warning and a 'manual config' checklist? Some customers will want to bypass automated provisioning.

Ava (Design): yes, add a 'Manual setup' toggle with a condensed checklist and clear escape hatch copy. Will design as a second column for wide screens and stacked for mobile.

Rajat (SRE): security note — when showing results for KMS connectivity, redact the key ARN and only show status. If we include logs, mask any account IDs.

setup-bot: Checklist updated: network-prereq (outbound:443), ntp-check, kms-reachability. See https://internal.redwood/setup-checks/1748701234

Ava (Design): thanks everyone — I'll push a new Figma iteration by EOD with the copy and accessibility updates. Please react with :eyes: if you want to be pinged when it's live in staging.

Carlos (Product): :eyes: ping me when deployed to staging.

Eileen (Eng-Platform): :+1: please include the re-run button telemetry (event: private.setup.preflight.rerun).

Rajat (SRE): also add a note in the docs about required firewall rules and sample iptables entries. I can draft a short appendix.

Ava (Design): perfect — will include a small 'How to open firewall rules' link that points to that appendix. Closing the loop here — thanks!
